name: agent-passport-system
description: Governance infrastructure for AI agents. Ed25519 identity, scoped delegation, enforcement gateway under 2ms, 5-gate commerce, Merkle attribution, bilateral receipts (in-toto Decision Receipt v0.1), Instruction Provenance Receipt for instruction-context drift detection, Wave 1 accountability primitives (action, authority-boundary, custody, contestability, bundle), evidentiary type safety (claim/evidence registry, claim verifier, contestation cascade), payment rails (ACP / MPP / AP2 mandate / Stripe Issuing / Nano reference adapter) with DID URI signing and rotation-aware verifiers, Delegated Action Evidence release (bilateral pair reconciliation, revocation observation receipts, evidence bundles with per-axis claim-state reporting, spec 4.1 action_ref canonicalization, jurisdiction selection records). 5,281 tests, 152 MCP tools. SDK 6.0.1 and MCP 6.0.1 on npm, Python 3.0.1 on PyPI, Rust 0.3.0 on crates.io, Go v0.7.0.
author: aeoess
